activity_summary: At breakfast there was snow, and you said the afternoon play was still two of the clock. The letter stayed for the carrier of the 27th. Board was threepence. The loaf was a penny and a finger short. You would not talk of yesterday. Mistress Ansell would not count a player's share on her board.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named two of the clock, kept the letter back, and would not talk of yesterday.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Fed him, refused to carry the letter, and refused to count a share.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Offered the fire for his boots, and reported the loaf a finger short.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The snow can thin a yard. It does not change the hour.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: I do not count players' shares.
